title: night_shift_baby_monitor
display_title: I found a baby monitor in my night shift break room — we don't have any babies here
beats: I found a baby monitor plugged into the break room outlet at the nursing home where I work (31F), and we don't have any infants on this floor.
I figured a coworker forgot it after a shower gift or something, so I unplugged it and left it on the counter.
The next night it was plugged back in, screen glowing, static hissing low.
I picked it up to turn it off and heard breathing through the speaker — slow, wet, not static.
I checked the camera feed out of instinct. It showed Room 14, empty bed, sheets pulled tight, no patient assigned there since a woman passed in it three weeks ago.
I asked the day shift nurse about the monitor. She looked at me funny and said, 'What monitor?'
It was gone from the counter by the time I turned around, and Room 14's door was open. What would you have done?
